grammarChart.example: The report is written by the manager.
The report has been written already.
The report will be written tomorrow.
The report must be written carefully.

explanation: Passive Voice digunakan ketika fokus utama kalimat adalah pada tindakan (action) atau objek yang menerima tindakan, bukan pada pelaku (doer). Dalam bahasa Indonesia, ini mirip dengan penggunaan imbuhan 'di-' atau 'ter-'. Contoh: 'Buku dibaca' (The book is read). Dalam konteks akademik (IELTS), passive voice memberikan kesan objektif dan formal karena mengalihkan perhatian dari subjek personal ke fakta atau proses.
keyRules: Rumus utama: To Be (sesuai tense) + Past Participle (Verb 3).
Gunakan 'by + agent' hanya jika pelaku sangat penting untuk diketahui.
Subjek dalam kalimat aktif berubah menjadi objek dalam kalimat pasif.
Tense pada kalimat pasif harus mengikuti tense kalimat aktifnya.
azarNotes: Ingat! Jangan tertukar antara Verb 3 (Past Participle) dengan Verb 2 (Past Simple). Contoh: 'It was written' (benar) vs 'It was wrote' (salah). Pastikan Anda menghafal daftar irregular verbs untuk menguasai ini.

examples.passive: New policies were implemented by the government.

examples.active: Scientists are studying the climate change.
examples.passive: Climate change is being studied by scientists.

commonMistakes: Lupa menggunakan 'be' (Contoh: 'The cake eaten' seharusnya 'The cake was eaten').
Menggunakan Verb 2 alih-alih Verb 3 (Contoh: 'It was took' seharusnya 'It was taken').
Menggunakan passive voice untuk kata kerja intransitive seperti 'leep', 'arrive', atau 'happen' (Kata-kata ini tidak bisa dipasifkan).
ieltsTip: Gunakan Passive Voice dalam IELTS Writing Task 1 (Process Diagram) untuk menjelaskan tahapan produksi. Gunakan juga dalam Writing Task 2 untuk menjaga nada formal dan objektif (misal: 'It is often argued that...' daripada 'I think that...'). Ini akan membantu Anda mencapai skor tinggi di kriteria Grammatical Range and Accuracy.

quiz.question: Ubah ke pasif: 'The company launched a new product last month.'
options: A new product was launched by the company last month.
A new product is launched by the company last month.
A new product was launch by the company last month.
A new product has been launched by the company last month.

quiz.question: Pilih struktur yang benar: 'The data _______ by the researchers.'
options: All of the above are correct depending on context

quiz.question: Ubah ke pasif: 'People should protect the environment.'
Manakah kalimat yang salah (Grammatically incorrect)?
options: The decision will be made soon.
